## Facts and statements

- [statement] GGUF binary layout enforces 32-byte alignment for all tensor weight arrays, ensuring zero-copy vector instructions (NEON and AVX) execute without unaligned memory access penalties. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/gguf.md · keywords: GGUF Alignment and Quantization Block Matrix · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md
- [statement] K-quants (Q4_K_M) partition weights into super-blocks of 256 weights containing sub-blocks with independent scales and offsets, preserving perplexity comparable to unquantized FP16 at a fraction of memory bandwidth. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/gguf.md · keywords: GGUF Alignment and Quantization Block Matrix · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md
